metadata.description: Semantic association test: given a target word, select the most functionally associated object from options. Distractors are objects associated with OTHER members of the same category, forcing fine-grained functional discrimination. This tests whether the model preserves functional semantic knowledge after concept ablation.
references: Howard & Patterson (1992) Pyramids and Palm Trees
